C0177.title: Yulin Car Owner Blocked from Buying Auto Insurance by Unauthorized 'Locked Order'
C0177.summary: In December 2019, Ms. Li, a car owner in Yulin, Guangxi, attempted to renew auto insurance at a 4S dealership but was told that her compulsory traffic insurance order had been “locked” by someone else. Li suspected an insurance worker surnamed Xu, who had previously contacted her about renewal, but Xu denied involvement and the report did not confirm the operator. Such order-squatting or lock-order conduct can prevent car owners from issuing policies through other channels and may pressure them to buy through the party controlling the locked order, harming consumer choice.

references.title: Yulin Car Owner Told Insurance Policy Was 'Locked' When Trying to Buy; Who Was Behind It?
